# TERMs with `line` `nucleating-argument`

*Lines of inquiry — A named line of the record's own argument, so that a line can be set aside as a whole and what depends on it can be found. Retracting a line is a status change on its members, never a deletion (ADR-032).*

**Nucleating an argument** — how an argument developed across stateless sessions settles into stable, addressable structure, and what a project memory contributes — the record itself as the case.

| [TERM-087](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-087.md) v2 | cut, and which sense: a Cartesian cut, Pattee's epistemic cut, or Barad's agential cut, enacted by an apparatus | Three senses of "cut" the exchange of 2026-10-27 used, which A9 §4 said "are not interchangeable concepts". The Cartesian cut is a separation of observer from observed taken as given before any measurement. Pattee's epistemic cut ([LIT-1190](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-1190.md), read in [NOTE-952](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-952.md)) is the functional separation of symbolic description from the dynamics it measures or controls, and is epistemic, not ontological. Barad's agential cut ([LIT-1653](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-1653.md), [LIT-1657](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-1657.md), both unavailable) is a differentiation enacted within a phenomenon by an apparatus, through which boundaries and properties become determinate. Proposed: the record had no word for them, and they recur in [CLAIM-476](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-476.md). | Proposed |
| [TERM-089](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-089.md) v2 | apparatus, in the operational sense: a realized organization that selectively couples differences in one system to distinguishable outcomes in another; by function it may differentiate, retain, enforce and revise, and the four come apart | The sense of "apparatus" the exchange of 2026-10-27 converged on from U19 to U23, stated so that no observer and no constitutive metaphysics is presupposed. An apparatus makes some differences in a system produce distinct outcomes in another (differentiation), and may keep them (retention), let them change what happens next (enforcement), and change its own criteria of discrimination (revision). Proposed: the record uses "apparatus" in [CLAIM-476](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-476.md) and [TERM-087](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-087.md) in Barad's sense, and needed a weaker one that a thermometer, a bacterium, a sensor network and luria all fall under without argument. | Active |
| [TERM-091](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-091.md) v2 | relational vocabulary, of a class of descriptions: the arities and kinds of relation it can state (pairwise or higher-order, among states or among histories, of which declared types), and so which constraints are expressible in it at all | What [QUESTION-283](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-283.md) asks about: whether composition can force a description to adopt relations its parts never needed. A sheaf on a graph has a pairwise vocabulary. Eliminating an interior can leave a constraint outside it ([THEORY-1090](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1090.md)). A luria record's relational vocabulary is its declared relation types and fields, and amendments that add one ([ADR-043](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-043.md), [ADR-044](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-044.md)) enlarge it. The term lets the record say that a constraint is inexpressible in a vocabulary, which is different from saying that it is false or unknown. Adopted 2026-10-29. | Active |
| [TERM-092](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-092.md) v2 | inquiry frontier, of an agent at a budget: the questions it can formulate, making them determinate enough to pursue, with the concepts, records, tools, time and computation it actually has; distinct from the questions its language can express, from those it can pursue to a stated standard, and from those that have answers | The object of [CLAIM-475](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-475.md), from A17 §§2 and 7 of the exchange of 2026-10-27. A question is on an agent's frontier if some procedure available to it, within its budget and horizon, makes the question determinate enough to pursue. Formulating counts against the budget as well as answering. The frontier moves when resources grow and when reusable specifications make formulation cheaper, and it can change shape as well as size. The term separates askable from expressible and from answerable, which [CLAIM-474](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-474.md)'s last failure turns on. Proposed. | Proposed |
